cases.current_line: I keep coming back to that idea that we're just a bundle of perceptions. I'm a different person at work than with my old friends. And the thing I said I'd host next month: every time something more fun comes up, I tell myself one more day of not preparing won't matter. Does anything I've read speak to that pull without making one side of me fake?
